description: The Rajasthan Regional AI Impact Conference 2026 concluded today in Jaipur, marking a historic shift in the state’s technological landscape. Held as a precursor to the National India AI Impact Summit, the event saw the official unveiling of the Rajasthan AI-ML Policy 2026, a comprehensive roadmap designed to integrate Artificial Intelligence into governance, healthcare, and education. A Massive Drive for Human Capital One of the most ambitious announcements made during the summit was the launch of a mega AI skilling program aimed at training 10 lakh (1 million) youth across the country.
